scope: Behind/front stacking, topAndBottom flow behavior and absolute y positioning for floats

implementation.behind: wp:wrapNone + behindDoc=1 → absolute overlay at left/top, z-index 0 (under body text which uses z-index 1)
implementation.front: wp:wrapNone + behindDoc=0 → absolute overlay at left/top, z-index 3 (above body text)
implementation.topAndBottom: in-flow block (clear: both) placed before the anchor block; occupies height so following text starts below
implementation.absoluteY: wrap float gets margin-top = max(0, float.y - measured flow height before the anchor); verified at y=100

remaining: VBA macros cannot run in the browser (same as Word for the web)
